shared_prompt: Create one implementation-facing square Doodad powerlifting smartwatch framebuffer. Use an exactly square full-bleed 240 x 240 canvas at high resolution with no watch case, bezel, border, caption, board, shadow, perspective, or environment. Preserve the near-black navy background, deep-indigo Material 3 Expressive surfaces, regular/medium sans serif, tabular hero numerals, off-white primary text, blue-gray secondary text, lavender current/primary, mint success, coral destructive, and amber assistance roles from the references. Use flat practical controls, the established rounded rectangles and spacing rhythm, one dominant number or decision, and a full-width inset bottom action. No logos, watermark, glossy 3D, neon, decorative outlines, athlete illustrations, circular medallions, tiny spreadsheet, or clipped text.

screens.role: Review the current routine and measurable goal before training.
screens.prompt: TRAINING hub with HEAVY DAY, 14 SETS · 3 LIFTS, current SQUAT 5RM progress 142.5 / 150 KG at 95%, workout and goal edit affordances, and DONE.

screens.role: Edit the lift order and prescriptions in Heavy Day.
screens.prompt: HEAVY DAY workout builder with 14 SETS; BACK SQUAT 5 × 5, BENCH PRESS 5 × 5, DEADLIFT 4 × 5, + ADD EXERCISE, and SAVE PLAN.

screens.role: Configure Back Squat work sets, reps, start load, rest, and warmups.
screens.prompt: BACK SQUAT prescription with dominant 5 SETS and 5 REPS controls, 140 KG start, 3:00 rest, automatic warmups, and DONE.

screens.role: Set a measurable 5RM target for Back Squat.
screens.prompt: STRENGTH GOAL for BACK SQUAT with a dominant 150 KG 5RM target, CURRENT 142.5 KG, 12 WEEKS, restrained mint progress accent, and SAVE GOAL.
